Based on the conversation so far, there have been no items added to the supply order. The only financial adjustment mentioned was a deduction:

- Take 35 off the order for the returned stock.

Since no positive line items were added to build up the order before this deduction, the total is currently negative or zero depending on how you view the starting point. However, typically an order starts at 0. If we assume the order started at 0 and only this deduction occurred:

Total: -35

If you intended for items to be added but haven't listed them yet, please provide the line items. If this deduction is the only entry, the total is -35.
